DOC.title: IELTS Listening test, conversation 1
DOC.instructions: Listen to a student talking to a college representative about foundation courses. Then answer the questions.

item.text: Which THREE of the following are features of foundation courses?

Complete the entry requirements below. Write no more than three words or a number for each answer.
